{
  "decision-shield-bias-from-probe-swap": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY run_id, proto_probe ORDER BY slip_id COLLATE BINARY) AS rn
  FROM bench_slip
  WHERE p_tenth IS NOT NULL AND q_tenth IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT p.run_id, 5 * ((p.p_tenth - p.q_tenth) + (q.q_tenth - q.p_tenth)) AS effect_centi_c,
       p.slip_id AS p_proto_slip, q.slip_id AS q_proto_slip
FROM ranked AS p
JOIN ranked AS q ON q.run_id = p.run_id
WHERE p.proto_probe = 'P' AND q.proto_probe = 'Q' AND p.rn = 1 AND q.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.run_id",
  "decision-shift-standardized-turnover": "WITH totals AS (
  SELECT site_code, shift_code, SUM(departures) AS departures, SUM(exposure) AS exposure
  FROM shift_counts
  GROUP BY site_code, shift_code
  HAVING SUM(exposure) > 0
)
SELECT d.site_code,
       (1000 * (d.departures * n.exposure + n.departures * d.exposure) + d.exposure * n.exposure) / (2 * d.exposure * n.exposure) AS standardized_per_1000
FROM totals AS d
JOIN totals AS n ON n.site_code = d.site_code
WHERE d.shift_code = 'day' AND n.shift_code = 'night'
ORDER BY standardized_per_1000 DESC, d.site_code ASC",
  "decision-simultaneous-terminal-bay-outages": "WITH RECURSIVE minutes(terminal_id, minute, end_min) AS (
  SELECT terminal_id, start_min, end_min FROM terminal_watch WHERE start_min < end_min
  UNION ALL
  SELECT terminal_id, minute + 1, end_min FROM minutes WHERE minute + 1 < end_min
)
SELECT w.terminal_id, COUNT(m.minute) AS blocked_minutes
FROM terminal_watch AS w
LEFT JOIN minutes AS m ON m.terminal_id = w.terminal_id
  AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.bay_code) FROM bay_outage AS o
       WHERE o.terminal_id = m.terminal_id AND o.bay_code IN ('A', 'B')
         AND o.failed_min <= m.minute AND m.minute < COALESCE(o.restored_min, m.end_min)) = 2
GROUP BY w.terminal_id
ORDER BY w.terminal_id",
  "decision-single-feed-finals-handoff": "SELECT c.slot_id AS copper_slot, j.slot_id AS jade_slot,
       (c.end_min - c.start_min) * c.viewers + (j.end_min - j.start_min) * j.viewers AS viewer_minutes
FROM air_slot AS c CROSS JOIN air_slot AS j
WHERE c.division = 'Copper' AND j.division = 'Jade'
  AND MAX(j.start_min - c.end_min, c.start_min - j.end_min) >= CASE WHEN c.hall = j.hall THEN 5 ELSE 15 END
ORDER BY viewer_minutes DESC, c.slot_id COLLATE BINARY ASC, j.slot_id COLLATE BINARY ASC
LIMIT 1"
}
